htn_kidney.title: The SGLT2i "canagliflozin" and the DPP-4i "sitagliptin" mitigate hypertensive nephropathy in adult male rats by modulating the Ang II/RAGE/Nox4/NLRP3 cascade.
htn_kidney.authors: Hassan FE, Al-Shahed FAN, Selmy A
htn_kidney.zhSummary: 该文聚焦高血压肾病，属于临床研究。核心观点：伴有进行性肾损伤的高血压肾病（HN）是动脉高血压（HTN）的常见后果。 临床提示：本研究探讨了钠-葡萄糖协同转运蛋白 2 抑制剂卡格列净 (Cana) 和二肽基肽酶 4 抑制剂西他列汀 (Sita) 对 HN 的肾脏保护作用。
htn_kidney.abstract: Hypertensive nephropathy (HN) with progressive renal damage is a common consequence of arterial hypertension (HTN). This study addresses the renoprotective attributes of the sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 inhibitor canagliflozin (Cana) and the dipeptidyl peptidase-4 inhibitor sitagliptin (Sita) on HN. Twenty-four adult male Wistar rats were categorized into four groups (six per group): control (CTRL), hypertensive nephropathy (HN); rats were given L-NAME (50 mg/kg, i.p., once a day), HN + Cana; rats were given L-NAME injections alongside oral Cana 10 mg/kg, and HN + Sita; rats were provided Sita 10 mg/kg concurrently with L-NAME injection. portal_hypertension.title: Catecholamines Activate a Tumour Progression Program in Differentiated Tumour Hepatocytes.
portal_hypertension.journal: Liver international : official journal of the International Association for the Study of the Liver
portal_hypertension.authors: Lelou E, Rauch C, Dubois-Pot-Schneider H
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：交感神经系统参与多种癌症的进展和侵袭性，包括肝细胞癌 (HCC)。 临床提示：然而，交感神经支配和儿茶酚胺对肿瘤肝细胞行为的具体影响仍知之甚少。
portal_hypertension.abstract: The sympathetic nervous system is involved in the progression and aggressiveness of several cancers, including hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). However, the specific effects of sympathetic innervation and catecholamines on tumour hepatocyte behaviour remain poorly understood. In this study, we aimed to investigate the role of sympathetic fibres and catecholamines in the progression of HCC. The distribution of sympathetic nerves was mapped in 10 human HCC samples using multiplex immunofluorescence labeling. Adrenergic receptors (ADR) and enzymes involved in catecholamine degradation were assessed in three HCC (HepaRG, BC2, Huh-7) and one hepatoblastoma (HepG2) cell lines. The impact of catecho...

portal_hypertension.title: The utility of STRIATIN as a novel diagnostic marker in cirrhosis.
portal_hypertension.journal: Arab journal of gastroenterology : the official publication of the Pan-Arab Association of Gastroenterology
portal_hypertension.authors: Vairappan B, Venkatesan V, Mohan P
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：内皮功能障碍和内皮一氧化氮合酶 (eNOS) 介导的一氧化氮 (NO) 生物利用度降低是与肝硬化相关的门静脉高压 (PHT) 发病机制的关键。 临床提示：Striatin 是一种调节 eNOS 激活的支架蛋白，在这方面可能发挥着至关重要但尚未探索的作用。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Endothelial dysfunction and endothelial nitric oxide synthase (eNOS) mediated reduction in nitric oxide (NO) bioavailability are pivotal in the pathogenesis of portal hypertension (PHT) associated with liver cirrhosis. Striatin, a scaffolding protein that regulates eNOS activation, may play a crucial but unexplored role in this context. This study aimed to investigate hepatic striatin expression and its association with eNOS in cirrhosis, assess systemic striatin concentrations in cirrhotic patients, and evaluate its potential as a diagnostic biomarker for PHT. A case-control study was conducted including 40 cirrhotic patients and 40 age- and sex-matched healthy controls. Hepatic striatin an...

portal_hypertension.title: Validation of a pan-ELastography Machine-learning (ELM) score to predict clinically significant portal hypertension in compensated advanced chronic liver disease.
portal_hypertension.authors: Giuffrè M, Kresevic S, Ravaioli F
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：临床上显着的门脉高压 (CSPH) 会导致晚期慢性肝病 (ACLD) 的失代偿和死亡。 临床提示：尽管非选择性β受体阻滞剂（NSBB）可降低风险，但准确识别CSPH患者需要有创肝静脉压力梯度（HVPG）测量。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Clinically significant portal hypertension (CSPH) drives decompensation and mortality in advanced chronic liver disease (ACLD). Although non-selective β-blockers (NSBB) reduce risk, accurate identification of patients with CSPH requires invasive hepatic venous pressure gradient (HVPG) measurement. The non-invasive Baveno-VII CSPH criteria based on liver stiffness measurement (LSM) and platelet count (PLT)-yield 40-50% indeterminate ("gray-zone") results and vary across etiologies and elastography techniques. Spleen stiffness measurement (SSM) has been proposed to improve the accuracy of the Baveno-VII CSPH criteria. We developed and validated a machine-learning (ML) model integrating pan-ela...

portal_hypertension.title: Comparison of left lateral and supine positioning for EUS-guided portal pressure gradient measurements.
portal_hypertension.authors: Lei Z, Luo S, Lu H
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：EUS 引导的门静脉压力梯度 (EUS-PPG) 通常在仰卧位进行，而左侧卧位是常规 EUS 的标准姿势。 临床提示：本研究旨在比较在左侧卧位和仰卧位获得的 EUS-PPG 测量结果。
portal_hypertension.abstract: EUS-guided portal pressure gradient (EUS-PPG) is typically performed in the supine position, whereas the left lateral position is standard for routine EUS. This study aimed to compare EUS-PPG measurements obtained in the left lateral and supine positions. In this prospective single-center study, patients with portal hypertension underwent EUS-PPG under moderate sedation. Portal vein and hepatic vein pressures were measured sequentially in both positions without repeat puncture. PPG was calculated as mean portal vein minus mean hepatic venous pressure. Feasibility and adverse events were recorded. Of 35 screened patients, 31 consented and 29 completed measurements in both positions; in 2 pati...

portal_hypertension.title: EUS Versus Transjugular Approaches for Portal Pressure Measurement and Liver Biopsy: A Cost-Effectiveness Analysis.
portal_hypertension.authors: Magahis PT, Ramai D, Wang TJ
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：我们评估了 EUS PPG-LB 与 TJ HVPG-LB 同步 PPG 测量和 LB 采购的成本效益。 临床提示：虽然经颈静脉 (TJ) 方法是肝静脉压力梯度 (HVPG) 测量的黄金标准，但内镜超声 (EUS) 引导的门静脉压力梯度 (PPG) 测量已成为一种可行的替代方法
portal_hypertension.abstract: While a transjugular (TJ) approach is the gold standard for hepatic venous pressure gradient (HVPG) measurement, endoscopic ultrasound (EUS)-guided portal pressure gradient (PPG) measurement has emerged as a viable alternative. A randomized trial demonstrated EUS outperforms TJ in achieving reliable PPG and adequate liver biopsy (LB). We evaluated cost-effectiveness of EUS PPG-LB versus TJ HVPG-LB for simultaneous PPG measurement and LB procurement. A decision tree model compared EUS PPG-LB and TJ HVPG-LB over a 1-year time horizon from the U.S. healthcare payer's perspective. Probabilities were derived from randomized trial data.
